biotools.summary: EasyDiver+ is a bioinformatics tool designed for analyzing high-throughput sequencing data from in vitro evolution of nucleic acids or amino acids. It enhances previous pipelines by incorporating advanced analytical capabilities, including the calculation of enrichment values and a flexible visualization platform.
